    "# tLEaP\n",
    "\n",
    "*Building and executing AmberTools tLEaP scripts in isolated working directories.*\n",
    "\n",
    "The `TLeap` class provides an isolated Python wrapper to build, parameterize, and execute AmberTools `tleap` commands safely without cluttering the global working environment.\n",
    "\n",
